verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a broad provider ecosystem: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes and 300+ providers (pulumi-gh-2), and a Registry listing 316 packages that is open to community contributions (pulumi-docs-59, pulumi-docs-60). Every supported language gets the full surface of all Registry providers (pulumi-docs-1). Hands-on users confirm managing GCP, AWS and Kubernetes together (pulumi-comm-12, pulumi-comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SaaS provider coverage beyond Cloudflare, and assurance on provider freshness, since one user reports the Azure provider lagged on deprecated APIs for months (pulumi-comm-5).
